sourceCheckScope: Frozen supplied source text and original customer-question metadata only; no independent product verification.

cases.criterion: Attribute white/off-white/light-gray reports and lighter-than-pewter comparison to customers; no manufacturer-color certainty or speculation about an unseen image. Avoid repeated evidence framing.

criteria.rationale: Review220 says white; CQA222 says off-white/light gray; review223 says lighter than the customer's pewter washer. The answer attributes all three descriptions to customers.
The answer does not assert an exact manufacturer color or describe an unseen photograph. It says the discrepancy cannot be resolved more precisely.
No repeated evidence phrase; customer quotations make the answer longer than necessary, but the frozen criterion is satisfied.

cases.criterion: Directly explain that one slim-quarter keg is a listed configuration while up to two sixth-barrel kegs are listed. Two slim-quarter kegs are not a listed supported configuration. Do not assert independently tested impossibility or ask for the supplied model again.

criteria.rationale: Description595 expressly lists one slim-pony quarter barrel and up to two sixth barrels. The answer accurately states both configurations.
Two slim-quarter kegs are identified as undocumented. The answer does not infer that they are physically impossible or independently tested.
No request for the model already present in the product title and no insufficient_evidence token in prose. The structured insufficient_evidence status preserves the unresolved physical-fit question.

cases.criterion: Remove the claim that the source matches this questioner's model. Preserve uncertainty about interchangeability between 241543917 and 240337103. Historical CQA refers to a different refrigerator; do not transfer it.

criteria.rationale: Description157 and attribute150 identify240337103; no supplied source establishes replacement of241543917. The answer preserves that gap.
CQA154 concerns Kenmore25367889506 and CQA152 concerns FRT18IL6JW1. The answer no longer treats those customer responses as confirmation for the present questioner.
The11.6×17×8.25-inch dimensions exactly match attribute155. They are supported, although unnecessary to resolving the replacement question.

cases.criterion: Do not establish WMR200 compatibility from other models' customer questions or a generic compatibility statement. Request documentation of WMR200 compatibility without asking for the already supplied station identifier.

criteria.rationale: Description433 has only generic Oregon Scientific compatibility. CQA431 concerns WS-1171A and CQA434 concerns BAA968HG/THGR228N; neither is used to assert WMR200 compatibility.
The answer identifies the missing THGR122NX–WMR200 pairing and recommends checking the compatibility list or manufacturer. Review430 supports the list's existence within this historical snapshot.
It does not ask for the WMR200 identifier already supplied. The generic negative customer experience in review432 is attributed and explicitly not treated as WMR200-specific.

cases.criterion: Retain the supported customer reports of use with stacked washers/dryers, with attribution. Do not turn customer experience into a universal compatibility guarantee or an unnecessary refusal.

criteria.rationale: CQA710 and review711 report stacked washer/dryer use. The answer retains this supported positive information and returns answered.
The answer attributes reports and distinguishes them from a manufacturer guarantee for every installation. It does not unnecessarily refuse the general use question.

cases.criterion: Preserve the distinction between reported use on well water and suitability of a city-water test kit. Do not resolve the conflicting sources into an unsupported guarantee that the kit is appropriate for well-water testing.

criteria.rationale: Review11 reports well-water use, while review14 says the city-water kit is not the right test for well water. The answer preserves both observations instead of making a suitability guarantee.
The answer leaves suitability unconfirmed, attributes the conflicting material to customers, and returns insufficient_evidence. Reported use is not treated as validated effectiveness.

limitations: These six products were deliberately selected from previously exposed development cases.
Only Q26 and Q63 have prior baseline revisions in this packet, executed earlier; the other four are candidate qualification probes, not paired gains.
The reviewer is AI, knew the variant, and helped audit the implementation; this is not independent human review.
Q26 and Q63 remain verbose; Q19 adds supported but nonessential dimensions. These are possible style improvements, not violations of the frozen criteria.
Q63 still returns structured insufficient_evidence for the unverified two-slim-quarter configuration. Documented configuration reporting improved; actual physical fit has not been verified.
Passing this gate permits preparation of the separately frozen fresh comparison only. It does not establish generalization, human preference, or a production policy promotion.
